skill.name: ecommerce-customer-service
skill.description: 当用户需要回答商品咨询、整理售前FAQ或起草售后解释时使用。输入商品链接或资料、买家问题与已确认的店铺规则，输出可复制回复和商家待核实事项。在线商品详情支持抖音与小红书，已有资料可直接起草；不自动发送消息或办理售后。来自 SocialDataX 社媒数据助手。
skill.summary: Draft customer replies and product FAQs from verified facts, with separate merchant checks and optional Douyin or Xiaohongshu product lookups.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: The 31 static flags reflect Markdown formatting, documented service URLs, scoped credential guidance, product identifiers, and readable Chinese text rather than detected attacks. A separate supply-chain risk exists because the examples automatically execute an unpinned npm package with local process privileges. No evidence found of prompt injection or intentional credential exfiltration in the reviewed files; the external package implementation was not reviewed.

remediation.issue: Online lookup examples automatically execute the mutable socialdatax-skills@latest npm release.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and lockfile integrity, require approval before installation, and run lookups with minimal credentials in an isolated environment.

content.value_statement: Customer questions often arrive with incomplete product facts and unclear store policies. This skill drafts evidence-based replies and separates missing information for merchant review.
actual_capabilities: Draft concise customer replies from supplied product facts, buyer questions, and approved store policies.
Guide optional Douyin product lookups by product ID or URL through the documented CLI or MCP tools.
Guide optional Xiaohongshu product lookups by SKU ID or URL through the documented CLI or MCP tools.
Build product FAQs with suggested answers, factual sources, applicable conditions, and update requirements.
Separate customer-facing replies from internal checks for missing specifications, stock, or order information.
Draft after-sales explanations using supplied facts and authorized remedies without claiming completed actions.
limitations: Cannot send messages, contact buyers, issue refunds, grant compensation, or modify products, orders, or accounts.
Cannot query order tracking, live inventory, refund progress, or after-sales processing status.
Online product retrieval supports Douyin and Xiaohongshu and requires external tooling, a SocialDataX API key, and sufficient service balance.
Reply accuracy depends on supplied or retrieved facts; missing specifications, delivery dates, and policy terms require merchant confirmation.

use_cases.title: Answer Product Questions
use_cases.description: Turn a buyer question and verified product details into a concise reply, with missing facts listed separately.

use_cases.title: Build a Product FAQ
use_cases.description: Organize recurring questions into answers with evidence, SKU conditions, and items requiring updates.

use_cases.title: Explain an Approved Remedy
use_cases.description: Draft an after-sales explanation from an authorized resolution without implying that a refund or compensation has already occurred.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Simple Reply
prompt_templates.prompt: The product is a 500 ml screw-top cup. The buyer asks about heat retention and delivery tomorrow. Draft a reply without inventing either detail.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: respond using limited supplied facts.

prompt_templates.title: Use Approved Store Policies
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these product facts: [facts]. Use these approved store policies: [policies]. Answer this buyer question: [question]. Separate merchant checks from the customer reply.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: combine product evidence and confirmed policy.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Product FAQ
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these product materials: [materials]. Build a FAQ for these recurring questions: [questions]. Include evidence, applicable SKUs, conditions, and facts requiring confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: organize multiple questions into a maintained reference.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile Conflicting Product Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this supported product URL: [URL], these supplied materials: [materials], and these buyer questions: [questions]. Identify conflicts and preserve SKU and price conditions. Draft replies without resolving uncertain facts in favor of a sale. Ask before installing external tooling.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: use optional retrieval and reconcile conflicting sources.

output_examples.input: A buyer asks how long a 500 ml screw-top cup retains heat and whether it arrives tomorrow. Neither detail is confirmed.
output: Customer reply: The cup holds 500 ml and has a screw-top lid. Heat retention and delivery by tomorrow are not yet confirmed.
Merchant checks: Verify tested heat retention, shipping availability, and order-specific delivery information.

output_examples.input: Approved policy allows returns within seven days for unused items. A buyer asks whether an unused item can be returned.
output: Customer reply: The store allows returns of unused items within seven days. Your purchase date needs checking to confirm eligibility.
Merchant checks: Verify the purchase date and any applicable product-specific conditions. No return or refund has been processed.

output_examples.input: Create a FAQ entry from confirmed materials stating that SKU A holds 500 ml. No capacity is confirmed for SKU B.
output: Suggested answer: SKU A holds 500 ml. Capacity for SKU B still needs confirmation.
Source and conditions: Supplied product materials; the confirmed capacity applies only to SKU A.
Update required: Obtain verified capacity for SKU B.

best_practices: Provide verified product facts, the exact buyer question, and approved policies before requesting a reply.
Review customer-facing text separately from internal checks, especially for delivery promises, refunds, compensation, and personal information.
Approve external tooling before execution, prefer reviewed pinned releases, and keep API keys out of prompts and generated files.
anti_patterns: Do not invent specifications, stock levels, delivery dates, certifications, or legal assurances.
Do not describe a refund, shipment escalation, or customer contact as completed without explicit supporting facts.
Do not treat product details as order status or use unsupported platform links as verified evidence.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Online retrieval also depends on available CLI or configured MCP tooling.

faq.question: Do I need an API key for every reply?
faq.answer: No. Supplied materials can support drafting without a key. Online product lookups require a SocialDataX API key and sufficient service balance.

faq.question: Which product links can it retrieve?
faq.answer: The documented lookups support Douyin and Xiaohongshu product URLs or platform-specific identifiers. For other platforms, provide the product materials directly.

faq.question: Can it send replies or issue refunds?
faq.answer: No. It drafts text only and cannot send messages, process refunds, grant compensation, or modify orders.

faq.question: What happens when information is missing or conflicting?
faq.answer: It identifies gaps or conflicts, avoids unsupported promises, and lists merchant checks separately from the customer reply.

faq.question: Does online retrieval introduce security risks?
faq.answer: The examples run an unpinned npm package. Review and pin the tooling, restrict credentials, and approve installation before use.
